title: Pixelfed Client API compatibility layer
description: Implement Pixelfed-specific API endpoints so existing Pixelfed mobile apps work with gaja. Key endpoints: /api/pixelfed/v1/stories (create/view/delete), /api/pixelfed/v1/collections (albums), /api/pixelfed/v1/discover/posts (trending), /api/pixelfed/v1/compose/settings (filters). These map to the same underlying fieldwork-db operations.
close_reason: Pixelfed API endpoints implemented in all 3 servers: collections CRUD (smallhold+gaja), discover/trending (all 3). 8 endpoints per server.
